  $location: GeoLocation,
  $offset: Int,
  $radius: Int,
  $sessionId: String!,
  $strictBounds: Boolean,
  $types: GooglePlacesType
) {
  addressAutoComplete(
    count: $count,
    countries: $countries,
    input: $input,
    language: $language,
    location: $location
    offset: $offset
    radius: $radius
    sessionId: $sessionId
    strictBounds: $strictBounds,
    types: $types
  ) {
    suggestions {
      addressText
      mainText
      placeId
      secondaryText
    }
  }
}"
